attchmntText: Laxmi India Finance Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Laxmi India Finance Limited published its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, in newspapers on November 14, 2026. The Board approved the results on November 13, 2026. Net profit after tax was 1,540.56 lakhs for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, compared to 944.1 lakhs for the same period in 2025. Earnings per share were 1.94 for the quarter. Semantic Infra-Tech Limited reported a net loss after tax of 5.94 lakhs for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Kinetic Engineering Limited reported a net loss after tax of 1,121 lakhs for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Team India Guaranty Limited reported a net profit after tax of 75.74 lakhs for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Vibhor Steel Tubes Limited and Manomay Tex India Limited also filed their unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Ammadoes Trading and Consultants Private Limited filed its unaudited financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.

attchmntText: Laxmi India Finance Limited has informed the Exchange about Link of Recording
voiceSummary: Laxmi India Finance Limited has made the audio recording of the earnings call available on its website. The call with analysts and investors was held on November 13, 2026. It discussed the Unaudited Standalone Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The recording is accessible at the link https://lifc.co.in/uploads/10049345.mp3. This disclosure is pursuant to Regulation 30 and 46 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The company previously sent letters on November 05, 2026, and November 13, 2026, regarding this matter. The communication was signed by Sourabh Mishra, Company Secretary and Chief Compliance Officer.

attchmntText: Laxmi India Finance Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Laxmi India Finance Limited filed an investor presentation for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, with BSE and NSE. The company reported Assets Under Management of Rs. 1,843.89 crore and Profit After Tax of Rs. 31.71 crore for H1 FY27. Net Interest Income stood at Rs. 96.83 crore. The external credit rating from Acuite is A with a Stable Outlook. Total Capital Adequacy Ratio is 22.95 percent. Gross Non-Performing Assets are 1.75 percent and Net Non-Performing Assets are 0.49 percent. The company operates 209 branches. The presentation is available on the company website at www.lifc.co.in.

attchmntText: Laxmi India Finance Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Laxmi India Finance Limited approved its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board received a limited review report with an unmodified opinion from statutory auditors S.C. Bapna & Associates. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, the company reported total income of 19,240.95 lakhs and a profit after tax of 3,197.82 lakhs. Earnings per share stood at 6.11 basic and 6.09 diluted. As of September 30, 2026, total assets were 216,428.80 lakhs, total liabilities were 166,572.59 lakhs, and total equity was 49,856.21 lakhs. The company also disclosed security cover and utilization of issue proceeds for non-convertible securities. The trading window for designated persons is open 48 hours after the declaration of these results.
